# Editorial credits {.unnumbered}

**Title:** Machine Learning and Automatic Classification with R  
**Subtitle:** A Practical Approach Using Real Open Data  
**Author:** Jesús Gilberto Rodríguez Escobedo  
**Place of publication:** San Luis Potosí, S.L.P., Mexico  
**Edition:** First edition, 2026  
**Formats:** interactive web edition, digital PDF edition, and executable Google Colab notebook  
**Primary implementation language:** R  
**Technologies:** Quarto, Shinylive, GitHub Pages, Google Colab, and YouTube  

This work was conceived as an open academic text for students, instructors, and professionals in engineering, mathematics, computing, statistics, data science, and applied sciences.

Trade names, trademarks, libraries, and platforms mentioned in this work belong to their respective owners and are included for academic, technical, and descriptive purposes.

## How to cite this work {.unnumbered}

Rodríguez Escobedo, J. G. (2026). *Machine Learning and Automatic Classification with R: A Practical Approach Using Real Open Data*. First edition. San Luis Potosí, S.L.P., Mexico.

## Complementary theoretical volume {.unnumbered}

The rigorous mathematical formulation of the methods is developed in the complementary theoretical volume *Mathematical Foundations of Machine Learning*.
